title: Making AI-Enhanced Videos: Analyzing Generative AI Use Cases in YouTube Content Creation
venue: Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI EA '25)
extended_summary:
This paper examines how generative AI tools are being used in real-world YouTube content creation workflows. The authors ask what specific tasks GenAI supports across the video production pipeline and how creators incorporate these tools in practice. Rather than evaluating learning outcomes, the paper maps practical use cases and discusses implications for future GenAI tool design.

The study analyzes 274 YouTube how-to videos posted between September 2023 and February 2024. Using YouTube Data API retrieval, manual screening, and thematic analysis of 2,829 segmented clips, the authors identified GenAI use cases across four phases of video creation: planning, production, editing, and uploading. Examples include identifying topics, generating scripts, creating prompts, producing visuals and voiceovers, lip-syncing avatars, upscaling visuals, translating speech, and generating subtitles and titles.

The context is an online creator community rather than a school setting. The paper shows that creators use GenAI to streamline labor-intensive creative tasks and that prompting skill is emerging as an important form of expertise. The authors also note concerns about originality, authenticity, and transparency of AI-generated content, including questions about labeling and platform visibility rules. Overall, the paper provides a conceptual framework for GenAI in video creation and suggests future research directions for supporting creators with more integrated and responsible tools.

identified_tools.name: ChatGPT
identified_tools.description: OpenAI's GPT-based conversational generative AI chatbot used for text generation and other content creation tasks.
identified_tools.use_case: Used to segment YouTube closed-caption transcripts into small clips; also used by creators in the analyzed videos to generate video scripts, refine prompts, suggest titles, and generate account/channel names.

identified_tools.name: Gemini
identified_tools.description: Google's generative AI conversational model used for text generation and related content-creation assistance.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed YouTube how-to videos as a tool for generating video scripts and suggesting visual ideas.

identified_tools.name: MidJourney
identified_tools.description: A text-to-image generative AI tool for creating images from prompts.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos for generating AI images and for exploring community-created prompts.

identified_tools.name: Leonardo.AI
identified_tools.description: A generative AI image and visual content creation platform.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos for producing images used in video content, including avatars and portraits.

identified_tools.name: Canva
identified_tools.description: A design platform with AI-assisted content generation and editing features.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos for generating images, filling image areas, and creating visual content for videos.

identified_tools.name: Leiapix
identified_tools.description: A generative AI tool for animating static images into short videos.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to transform static images into short-form video clips.

identified_tools.name: KreadoAI
identified_tools.description: An AI avatar generation platform for creating talking-head style digital presenters.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos for creating human-like avatars used in news-style videos.

identified_tools.name: Invideo AI
identified_tools.description: An AI-assisted video creation/editing tool that can suggest stock footage and assemble video content.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos for suggesting stock footage based on script text.

identified_tools.name: ElevenLabs
identified_tools.description: An AI voice generation/text-to-speech platform for producing synthetic speech audio.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to create voiceovers for video narration.

identified_tools.name: Suno AI
identified_tools.description: A generative AI music and sound creation tool.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to generate background music/songs from user-provided lyrics.

identified_tools.name: Vidnoz AI
identified_tools.description: An AI video creation platform with avatar, lip-sync, and script-to-video features.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos for lip-syncing avatars to uploaded scripts in news-style videos.

identified_tools.name: DomoAI
identified_tools.description: A generative AI tool for restyling images and videos.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to transform video clips into different visual styles.

identified_tools.name: ComfyUI
identified_tools.description: A node-based interface for generative image/video workflows, often used for upscaling and other visual generation tasks.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to upscale animated videos and improve resolution.

identified_tools.name: Autopod
identified_tools.description: An AI video editing tool that automatically segments and clips long-form video content.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to break podcasts into shorter clips based on an automatic scoring mechanism.

identified_tools.name: Lut
identified_tools.description: An AI visual editing tool used for applying visual effects and style adjustments to images/videos.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to add color tints and other visual effects to images.

identified_tools.name: Wondershare Virbo
identified_tools.description: An AI video/avatar tool for translating scripts and generating lip-synced avatar videos.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to translate scripts between languages and then automatically lip-sync the output.

identified_tools.name: Descript
identified_tools.description: An AI-assisted audio/video editing platform with speech editing and transcription features.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to remove pauses and unnecessary script sections from speech and video.

identified_tools.name: wave.video
identified_tools.description: An AI-assisted video platform that can transcribe video and generate subtitles/captions.
identified_tools.use_case: Observed in analyzed videos to transcribe content and automatically add subtitles.

quality_tier_rationale: This is a qualitative/mixed-methods content analysis of YouTube how-to videos, not an intervention study or controlled evaluation. The paper provides descriptive evidence about tool use but no causal impact estimates.
impact_tier_rationale: The paper documents broad creator use cases across many tools, but it does not measure learning, coaching outcomes, or other educational impact. Reported effects are descriptive only, so the impact on schooling or instruction is unclear.
